    Profile

    Icona is a leading engineer from the Acedia Belt Region. She believes that researchers must devote themselves to experimenting with magic for future generations with infinite possibilities. She is unconventional in her methods by being solely focused on researching, without regard for whether the work is for good or evil.

    Origin: Acedia Belt Region
    Gender: Female
    Height: 164cm
    Weight: 40kg
    Birthday: Oct 29
    Blood Type: Type Pa
    Zodiac: Moon of the Fiery Imperial Skies
    Likes: Materials for experiments
    Hobbies: Talking to herself
    Illust: ハカセスイッチ
    CV: 櫻弥恵
